record.paper: Subdivisions in digraphs of large out-degree or large dichromatic number

dossier_meta.paper: Subdivisions in digraphs of large out-degree or large dichromatic number
dossier_meta.context_text: Oriented trees are known to be $\delta^0$-maderian with $\mathrm{mader}_{\delta^0}(T) = |T|-1$ via a greedy procedure, but whether they are $\delta^+$-maderian is open. This is posed as a natural weaker step towards Mader's Conjecture 2. The paper provides evidence by proving in-arborescences are $\delta^+$-maderian (Theorem 23) and all oriented paths are $\delta^+$-maderian (Corollary 20).
